summary: Read whether response headers are committed.

target.notes: False before commit; true after writeHead, flushHeaders, first write, or end commits the header block.

semantics.notes: False before commit; true after writeHead, flushHeaders, first write, or end commits the header block.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.
